title: pm: the handover checklist names release, the decision inbox and carded obligations; two local handover checks
body:
Fixes #23396
Clause-②: no

Implements ruling `6162084315` (letter A) on #23396 under the claim `6162205633`: the handover checklist gains its three missing steps, the filing gate gains the carrier sentence, and two local, read-only script checks land beside them. One PR, as the claim set out: `.claude/**` is in the diff, so the PR is governed whole (Tier S) and stays a draft.

## The ruling's clauses, mapped to the diff

| Ruling clause | Where it landed |
|:--|:--|
| Every ledger obligation carries a card; a conditional one is `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` (time-triggered: `Restart-when:`); the vacant body holds pointers only | `seat-post-protocol.md` step 4 (new) |
| Every card this seat claimed is landed or released in one write (`Release:` + assignee cleared) and moved to its real state | `seat-post-protocol.md` step 2 (rewritten) |
| Every card awaiting the maintainer carries `needs-user-decision` and nothing else | `seat-post-protocol.md` step 3 (amended) |
| The step naming the pre-handover check gives the command and requires exit 0 before the vacant body | `seat-post-protocol.md` step 5 (new) |
| "The next PR that touches X" is not a carrier; a follow-up a landed work item owes is filed, outside the noise clause | `filing-gate.md` line 22 (new) |
| 2(a) `post-stamped.mjs --body` refuses a vacant body whose ledger holds an obligation line without `#N` | `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (pure core + 27-case battery) |
| 2(b) pre-handover check: unreleased claim / decision outside the inbox | `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` (new, 30-case self-test) |
| No twin moves | `SKILL.md` has no checklist twin (grep `收班` / `交接` / `释放`: only pointers to this file); `references/core-rules.md` does not exist |

### How the net-zero lines were paid

No ceiling moved. Each freed line comes from deleted text, never a pure re-wrap: every fold below joins lines whose bytes sum to more than 120, so it could not fit without deleting bytes, and what it deletes is restated elsewhere.

- **Old step 7 deleted.** "移交中 PR 的定时器随 PR 走" restates step 6's "随移交物转交"; "留守保留的定时器只触点名项" restates line 38's "残余定时器同界".
- **Old steps 8 + 9 fold** (223 B → 117 B). "归档义务 ⛔ 不可移交" restates "由离任 PM 自己". "跟完 … ⛔ 不随交接转移" restates `seat-lifecycle.md:30`: replies, liveness probes and re-dispatch stay only in the dispatching session.
- **Old step 2 becomes clause B.** "收不完留守或热移交" restates line 33. "⛔ 不为清零而等" restates `seat-lifecycle.md:41` ("不是在飞归零").
- **Clause C is appended to step 3**, inside its own 120-byte budget. Step 3 already enumerates the decision box.
- **filing-gate.md lines 30–31 fold.** Line 31's "当前组未经维护者确认 ⛔ 不预备再下一组、不提前展开全部批次" restates "只备下一组" within a group of ten the maintainer confirms. ⚠️ Line 31 is the text a prior PR (#20108) landed. The fold keeps its rule, but a reviewer who wants that wording verbatim should say so. No other line in the file restates another.
- **Bytes, stated:** `seat-post-protocol.md` 7,018 → 7,137 (+119). `filing-gate.md` 5,225 → 5,242 (+17).

## The three predicates, with the exact strings they key on

**Vacant body** (`seatPostVacancy`, post-stamped):
- The Current-PM section is the first `##` heading matching `CURRENT_PM_HEADING`, down to the next `##`. That pattern matches `Current PM` (any case) or `当前 PM`.
- The body is vacant when the **first** seat-status token in that heading or section is `⏳` and its next word is `vacant`, emphasis skipped (`⏳ **vacant**`, `**⏳ vacant**`). The tokens are `SEAT_STATUS_TOKENS`: `🟢`, `⏳`, `⏸`.
- Positional, not containment. Measured on the 22 open `pm:seat` bodies: #7623 is seated, yet its Current-PM section says "Seat 2 (#19287) ⏳ vacant" two lines under its own `🟢`. A containment test would have refused a seated post's refresh.

**Ledger section and obligation line** (`vacantLedgerRefusals`, post-stamped):
- **Ledger** = every line after the Current-PM section, minus fenced code, inline code, table rows, blockquotes and headings. It is not the `Ledger` heading alone: four of the six obligations the card measured on #6023 sit under `## 4. Notes`, as `Carried` lines.
- **Obligation line** = a ledger line carrying a key from `LEDGER_OBLIGATION_KEYS`, read where the key means a duty:
  - `Carried` / `欠` only as the item's first word.
  - `owe(s/d/ing)` / `欠` only on a group label (a line ending `:`) or a heading.
  - `Carrier:` / `承接者:` only as a capitalised clause at a clause start.
  - `next PR|change|edit|push` / `下一个碰` anywhere.
  - A list member under a keyed group label or keyed heading is an obligation line too. The label itself is never judged.
- **Passes** when the line carries `#N` or `owner/repo#N` outside code, or sits under a list item that does. When the line names its carrier (`Carrier:`), the card must be in that clause.
- **Pointers and facts are not refused.** A pointer line `→ #N` carries its card. A fact line (`Landed: …`, `Closed this shift:`) carries no key, so it is never judged.
- **Why the keys are positional:** read anywhere, `owe` and `carrier` refused five lesson bullets on #6024 (`no objection owed`, `owes a changeset`, `DUAL carrier:`), none of them a duty.
- **Measured on the live corpus:**
  - #6023's four `Carried` lines are refused: three with carrier "the next PR touching X" / "the next checklist-author sweep", one with no carrier.
  - #22648 is refused on four lines whose carrier is "the next change to …" or none, and #6021 on its group "Stale comments to ride the next edit".
  - The other vacant bodies, every seated body, and #18883's ledger and notes read as if vacant, all pass.
- **Stated limit:** the ruling's grain is the line. #6023's "B′ (an audit card) is owed …" shares a line with `#23177` and passes. Whether a cited card is still open is a live read, which this offline core does not do.

**Decision pending outside the inbox** (`decisionOutsideInbox`, check-handover):
- An open issue on which the departing session's latest comment authored by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` and carrying `--session` contains the `os-decision-facets` token.
- The token is read by `hasDecisionFacetMarker`, a literal containment test, so the plain line and its HTML-comment wrapping both read.
- No later comment classifies as a ruling under `check-prior-rulings.mjs`'s `classifyRulingComment` (`Ruling:` / `Ruling addendum` / `Ruling recorded`).
- The card's states (`PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`) are anything other than `needs-user-decision` alone.

**Unreleased claim** (`claimHolding`, check-handover):
- An open `pm:dispatched` issue whose assignees include `--account` and whose newest `Claim:` comment carries `--session`.
- Hit when no `Release:` comment carrying `--session` is newer than that claim. Both markers are read through the patrol's `markerMatches`, so a bolded `**Release:**` reads.

### Two readings past the dispatch's literal spelling

- **(a) is scoped by the claim, not the assignee alone.** Accounts are shared across seats, so a card under the departing account may be held by another live session. Such a card is listed, not refused, and so is a card with no claim at all.
- **(b) declines a card whose ruling was recorded after the analysis.** The director writes `Ruling:` and moves the card's state, while the departing seat's analysis stays its latest comment there. Read literally, (b) would refuse every handover that followed an ordinary ruling.

## Why a sibling file, not a mode of `check-half-states.mjs`

`check-half-states.mjs` is report-only by its header contract ("the workflow never fails a build over findings"). This check exists to exit non-zero on a finding. A mode would put a second contract inside a 35k-line patrol.

So `check-handover.mjs` imports the patrol's readers and transport pieces, and `classifyRulingComment` from `check-prior-rulings.mjs`; none is restated, and its self-test pins that:
- readers: `labelNames`, `latestMarkedComment`, `markerMatches`, the claim and release markers, `hasDecisionFacetMarker`, `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`, `pmLabelListingPath`, `OPEN_LISTING_PAGE_CEILING`;
- transport: `proxyRearmPlan` (under its own guard name), `classifyTransportProbe`, `describeTransportRoute`.

It is GET-only. Exit codes: 0 clear, 1 usage, 2 refused, 3 prerequisite not met, 4 no verdict (a read failed or a ceiling bound).

The optional `post-stamped --body` → `check-handover` call is **not** done. The departing session id is prose in the vacant body ("Previous holder: … `session_…`"), not a field, and reading it would need a parsing rule the ruling did not define.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** 收班交接清单补上三步:认领的卡收班前要么落地、要么同笔释放;等你裁决的卡只挂 `needs-user-decision`;台账里每条欠账都要有卡号,空座位正文只放指针。立卡门补一句:「搭下一个碰 X 的 PR」不算承接者,已落地工作欠下的后续照常立卡。另加两个本地脚本:写空座位正文时,有欠账行没卡号就拒写;收班前跑一个检查,还有没释放的认领、或决策卡不在你的收件箱,就拒绝交接。

**为什么改:** 上一班 devx 席按清单逐条做完,仍留下三类残缺,都要你亲自指出:认领没释放,两张决策卡没进收件箱,六条欠账没卡号。你的裁决选了 A:规则写进清单,再用两个脚本拦住。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 不进 CI,不加 Actions 时长,两个脚本只在本地跑。留守的在飞卡用 `--stay-behind=#N` 声明,并写在空座正文的 `Stay-behind:` 行上,检查只报告不拒绝(第二轮,总监裁 B)。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** 无。Tier S:席位出同档复审记录后入队落地。

## Acceptance notes

**Gates:** listed above, all on `79e0a8838`. The local self-test of `check-handover.mjs` runs in no workflow, by the ruling ("two local scripts, no CI time"). `check-self-test-wired` does not count it, because no workflow and no root alias names it.

**Owed, not written by this PR:** the `skip-changeset` label. Nothing here ships: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` are in no package's `files[]`. The dispatch's write budget names no label write.

**Open questions for the director** (answered in round 2: Q1 → B, implemented below; Q2 → A, the follow-up for C is #23420)**:**
1. **Stay-behind against check (a).** `seat-post-protocol.md` lines 33, 38 and 40 still let a departing seat stay behind (留守) on named tails after its vacant body. New step 2 and check (a) refuse while such a tail is held.
   - A: keep as ruled. A tail lands or is released before the vacant body, so 留守 means staying seated until then. Lines 33/38/40 then owe an edit.
   - B: a declared stay-behind list (`--stay-behind=#N,…`) that the check reports instead of refusing, cross-checked against the body's stay-behind line. This narrows the ruled predicate, so it needs the director's word.
   - C: run the check before the closing brief rather than before the body.
   - Recommendation: B. It keeps the stay-behind protocol coherent and still refuses the measured half-state, because #23193 was never a declared tail.
2. **Recall of check (b).** Neither measured analysis (`6141962120`, `6147446653`) carried the facet token, so (b) as ruled would not have fired on the measured shift. Its recall is the four-facet filing duty's.
   - A: keep.
   - B: also key on an analysis heading. That is a reader built from imagination.
   - C: make the token mandatory on a comment-anchored analysis and refuse its absence at `post-stamped --comment`.
   - Recommendation: A now, with C as a follow-up card.

**Out of scope, noted not filed:**
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:53` defines `carrier:` as "将碰该文件的 PR 或人". Read loosely, that is the "next PR touching X" the filing gate now says is not a carrier. A twin wording outside this claim's surface. Carrier: the director seat, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`.
- `seat-post-protocol.md:29` lists what `post-stamped --body` intercepts (unread knocks) and does not mention the new vacant refusal. Left alone under "nothing else moves". Same carrier.

## Round 2 (director's answers: Q1 -> B, Q2 -> A)

- **Q1 -> B, implemented.** `check-handover.mjs --stay-behind=#N[,#N…] --body-file=PATH`. A card held under this session's claim is reported as `[stay-behind] #N` (exit 0) only when it is listed on the command line AND declared on the vacant body's `Stay-behind:` line. Listed-but-undeclared or declared-but-unlisted stays `[claim-unreleased]` (exit 2).
- **Input: `--body-file`, not `--seat`.** Step 5 runs before the vacant body exists, so the live post would still be the seated body. The file also needs no request.
- **Charter text unchanged.** Step 5 keeps its 120 bytes because the refusal names both flags. Lines 33/38/40 stand.
- **Q2 -> A, kept.** (b) still keys on the `os-decision-facets` token; the follow-up for C is #23420.
- **(b) fix.** A live run refused the dispatching session on this card's own round-1 report, which quotes the token inside fenced JSON. The marker is now read with code blanked (`carriesFacetMarker`). Measured over two days of comments: 20 real markers, none in code; 3 quotations, all in code.
- **Verification on `9862e23b0`.** Self-tests: check-handover 46/46, post-stamped 657/657, check-half-states 4916. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
